items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: I had a big office next to Steven Spielberg in Universal Studios

ctx.x: Okay so you got immersed in W-9s and paperwork and like almost like a real job but you were still a musician.

I had a big office next to Steven Spielberg in Universal Studios with a big practice room and I had a golf cart to go to the show every morning to record, you know. I thought I died and went to heaven, believe me. Because previous I’m on the road doing one- nighters you know. I landed in Heathrow Airport, someone’s supposed to pick me up, they’re not there, I’ve got to find my way to the gig. Now I’m ten minutes from my house to Universal Studios. I’ve got the golf cart, I’ve got the office, I mean this was like…
Your mentioning going to Heathrow and, I’m guessing you did a certain amount of showing up and playing with a local rhythm section?
